mechanism: Systemic absorption of ophthalmic timolol (beta-blocker) combined with furosemide-induced hypokalemia and volume depletion may potentiate hypotension, bradycardia, and electrolyte disturbances.
action: Monitor blood pressure, heart rate, and serum potassium regularly; consider potassium supplementation with furosemide; educate patient on punctal occlusion to minimize systemic absorption of timolol drops.
